name: Interview
description: Capture interview questions, responses, concrete examples, and follow-up topics.

sections.title: Interview focus
sections.instruction: Summarize the stated purpose and topics covered. Cite the supplied source tags

sections.title: Questions and responses
sections.instruction: Pair significant questions with concise, attributed responses. Cite the supplied source tags for both the question and the response when available

sections.title: Examples and observations
sections.instruction: Record concrete examples and stated observations. Separate what the interviewee said from interviewer assessment and cite support for each point

sections.title: Questions to revisit
sections.instruction: List unanswered questions and gaps that participants identified. Cite where each came up and avoid inferring traits or conclusions
